instruction: Buy me a cutting board on amazon with at least 4.1 seller rating that will fit in my kitchen drawer of 12.0X9.5 (LxW) inches.
notes: Single-app purchase task. The seller-rating and product-type constraints are enforced by parameterizing search_products with product_type and min_seller_rating tied to static requirement facts; the drawer-fit constraint (length <= 12.0, width <= 9.5) is modeled as a runtime check performed via show_product against the target drawer object, which asserts (verified-fits ?p). The cart is cleared before adding the product with quantity 1 so the resulting order contains exactly one product with quantity 1, as the evaluation requires (CartEntry changes are ignored by the evaluation). Existing amazon address and payment card ids are discovered with show_addresses/show_payment_cards (no address modification). The goal uses the nullary (order-placed), which is reachable only through the constrained chain search -> show_product -> clear_cart -> add_product_to_cart -> place_order; complete_task requires it and is forced last. Search/show_product do not need a token, so the planner may reorder them before login; that is still a valid API sequence. No answer is needed, so complete_task has no parameters.
